search_text: published ZDI-14-210 ZDI-CAN-2120 Hewlett-Packard IT Executive Scorecard fndwar Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-06-18 CVE-2014-2611 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-2611 9.0 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['IT Executive Scorecard'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard IT Executive Scorecard. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the fndwar web application. A directory traversal vulnerability can be leveraged to create an arbitrary delete or disclose information. This can allow for a remote attacker to execute code under the context of the SYSTEM user. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
